Needs changes before merge.

This is a new review of the same head at the Opus tier. The PR adds geometry (`camcraft-geometry`), so it is under the safety floor. The two earlier reviews on this head were at a lower tier. This review replaces them.

**What looks good**

- `InsertText` checks all input in `new()`. A refused text does not go into the history. `apply` and `invert` are name-keyed, and `invert` removes only a sketch. This is the same pattern as `ImportDxf`.
- The name rules are the same as in `ImportDxf` (`crates/app/src/commands/import_dxf.rs:139`).
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in non-test code. `stroke_text::sketch` refuses a rejected chain and a bad nesting by name. No text profile can hold a rejected chain.
- The angle normalization keeps the angle in (-180, 180]. I checked the values -180, 180 and 540.
- Each new module has a provenance line. Each new file is below 400 lines. The new tests are in the correct crates (`crates/geometry/tests/`, `crates/app/tests/`).
- No process file changes. No `Cargo.toml` change. No new dependency. No snapshot PNG.
- `Refs #2679` is correct for a first slice. The body has a `Changelog:` line.

**Safety-tier checks (by reading)**

- I checked each line of the inline golden `GOLDEN_SN_0471` (`crates/geometry/tests/stroke_text.rs:776`) against the glyph table and the advance `(width + GAP) * unit`. All 9 lines agree. The bound `max [39, 6]` in the MCP test agrees.
- I checked each glyph against the chain rule (a chain cannot branch). Each stroke end that touches a different stroke is inside one line primitive of that stroke, not at a primitive end. Examples: the bar of `A`, the stem of `T`, the leg of `R`, the stem of `Y`, the upper bowl of `8`, the lower bowl of `3`.
- The smallest distance between two different primitive ends in one glyph is 0.5 font units. At the smallest cap height (0.5 mm) this is 0.042 mm. This is more than the join tolerance of 0.01 mm. Adjacent glyphs are separated by `GAP` = 2 font units or more.
- No existing golden moved. No `.nc`, `.cl` or snapshot file changes. The PR posts no G-code: generation from a profile stays refused by name on `main` until #1869.

**Results merged with main**

Not built in this review. The trial merge with `upstream/main` (`5fdbed9bd`) was clean.

The local build could not start. This machine sets `RUSTC_WRAPPER` to sccache for all processes. The sccache server did not respond, and each `rustc` call through it stopped with no progress (`simd-adler32`, `float-cmp`). The review session could not clear `RUSTC_WRAPPER`. A `--config build.rustc-wrapper` flag does not override the environment variable. The PR author saw the same sccache problem (see the PR body).

Because of this:

- Quick gate: not run by this review. The earlier local review on this head (comment 1) reports 945 of 948 steps passed. The 3 failed steps are UI suites that could not get a graphics adapter. The PR changes no UI code.
- Clippy: not run by this review. The earlier review and the author report `-D warnings` green for all eight crates.
- Mutations: not run by this review. The earlier review re-ran two mutations (empty-text guard, height guard): both red, then green when restored. The author table lists nine mutations.

**Heavy lanes**

- The diff reaches the Motion and App heavy lanes.
- The author ran `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on this head: exit 0, 217 steps, 0 failed. Motion: 56 passed, 2 expected failures (#1950). App: 42 passed, 1 expected failure (#1950).
- This review did not run the heavy lanes.

**Extra suites run**

None. Rule 1 does not apply: the diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no fixture or golden directory. Rule 2 does not apply: the diff does not touch the STEP, mesh or model import code.

**Requested before merge**

1. `crates/app/src/mcp/sketch_tools.rs:35` - The script verb and the skill row are missing, and no follow-up issue records them. AGENTS.md "Commands ship with an MCP tool" requires the MCP tool "and script verb where applicable", or a `source:agent` follow-up issue `MCP: <command>` that the PR body names. A script verb is applicable here: the sibling command `ImportDxf` has `cam.importDxf` (`crates/app/src/script/mod.rs:93`). The `insert_text` row in `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` is also missing (P5 work). The PR body lists the two items as open work but names no issue. Do this:
   - File one issue `MCP: InsertText` with the labels `source:agent`, `area:mcp`, `P5` and an effort label. Put the script verb `cam.insertText` and the skill row in it.
   - Name that issue in the PR body.
   This is a change to the PR body only. No code change is necessary.

**Notes (not blocking)**

- `crates/app/src/commands/insert_text.rs:78` - The placement check limits only the baseline start. A long text can go past the edge of the stock top. This has no effect now, because generation from a profile is refused. When #1869 adds Engrave on sketch chains, the operation must refuse or show a text that is outside the stock.
- `Refs #2679` keeps #2679 open. This is a `feat`, so it merges at the next minor cut.
- A re-review after the fix must build this head. Before that re-review, restart the sccache server on this machine or run the review with `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1 RUSTC_WRAPPER=`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Verdict: Ready to merge.

I read the full diff of head `c8734b449` against `origin/main`. I did not build, test or run mutations. The build evidence comes from the author and from the earlier collaborator reviews on this head.

**Blockers**

None.

**Checks by reading**

- Glyph origin: `crates/geometry/src/stroke_text/glyphs.rs:1` states that each glyph is drawn from scratch on a 4 x 6 grid, and that no font file and no other stroke font was consulted. The table is 47 short rows of straight strokes with cut corners. It is not a Hershey or other bundled set, so no entry in `assets/ui/LICENSES.md` is necessary. `mod.rs`, `insert_text.rs` and both test files have a provenance line.
- Chain rule: I checked the glyphs where a stroke end touches a different stroke (`B`, `K`, `P`, `R`, `T`, `Y`, `1`, `3`, `6`, `8`, `9`). Each end is inside a segment of the other stroke, not at a vertex. `stroke_text::sketch` refuses a rejected chain and a bad nesting by name, so a text profile cannot hold a bad chain.
- Validation at creation: empty and blank text, more than 256 characters, a character with no glyph (lower case is refused, not changed), cap height 0.5 to 1000 mm, spacing 0 to 1000 mm, NaN and infinity for height, spacing, X, Y and angle, X and Y past `sketch::MAX_OFFSET`, an unknown setup, a setup with no stock, a reserved or used name. The length check comes before the allocation of the strokes. Spacing cannot be negative, so two glyphs cannot overlap. The largest pen position is about 6e5 mm, so the float math has no overflow risk.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests.
- Command: `apply` and `invert` are the same name-keyed pattern as `ImportDxf` (`import_dxf.rs:154`). `invert` removes only a `Sketch` entity. The `Sketch` data is an `Arc` in a component and is freed with the entity. The undo and redo test compares the restored component and the placement.
- Schema: `schema.rs` changes only a doc comment. The project format does not change. `a_text_profile_saves_and_loads_with_its_strokes_and_place` pins save, load and save to the same bytes.
- MCP: `insert_text` calls `InsertText::new` and `History::execute`, the same command path. Each refusal is the command text. `site/content/guide/automate/mcp.md` has the row. The script verb `cam.insertText` and the `camcraft-mcp` skill row are tracked in #2891 (`source:agent`, `area:mcp`, `P5`, `effort:medium`), and the PR body names it.
- UI: the PR has no UI file. The body says that the command and the MCP tool are the only doors. The UI stays open work under #2679 (`Refs #2679`).
- Tests: the geometry tests are in `crates/geometry/tests/stroke_text.rs`. The app tests in `crates/app/tests/insert_text.rs` import `camcraft_app` items. Both files have a Gate map line. All files are below 400 lines. No snapshot PNG, no `.nc` and no `.cl` file changes.
- Process: `docs/decisions/2679-engrave-typed-text.md` is present. The body has a `Changelog:` line and `Refs #2679`. No `Cargo.toml` change and no new dependency.
- Earlier findings on this head: the "Needs changes" review asked for an `MCP: InsertText` follow-up and the heavy-lane evidence. #2891 exists with the requested labels, and the body links it. The body has the heavy-lane section for this head. The last collaborator review built a trial merge with `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1` and reports all non-UI suites green. The 11 UI failures are the graphics-adapter limit of that machine, and the PR changes no UI code. The evidence agrees with the requests.

**Notes (not blocking)**

- `crates/app/src/commands/insert_text.rs:84`: the range check limits only the start of the baseline. A long text can go past the edge of the stock top. Now this has no effect, because generation from a profile is refused by name. The work that adds Engrave on sketch chains (#1869) must refuse or flag a text profile that is outside the stock.
- `crates/app/src/commands/insert_text.rs:116`: a stated name has no length limit. This is the same rule as `ImportDxf`, so it is not new to this PR.
- This is a `feat` PR.
